notes.title: SCP-455 is back!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

After a long silence I am proud to announce SCP-455 is back, it was a weird year or so and the game has gone to some weird places across the web but now it is 100% final and ready to go!

The game puts you through a series of mazes crawling with different types of SCP Entity, these can range from the ever so annoying Weeper all the way up to the terrifying Stalker (More to come on these soon)

So how does the story go?

You can your team have been tasked with scouting SCP-455 after a group of high level scientists went missing on a routine experiment, considering the nature of SCP-455 the project has been classified and you have been given little to no information on what you are being put up against. It is not long before you find yourself alone in an ever-changing labyrinth and must make your way to the surface. How long will you survive?



Thanks for reading, for those who are curious the game is SINGLEPLAYER and with no hope of Multiplayer as I am putting all of my multiplayer efforts into "Survive The Backrooms" which is along the same lines but featuring different Backrooms, Entities and of course supporting up to 8 players. Be on the look out for that if you are interested in Backrooms type games too.
